policy_statement.policy_description: OR filing required due to physical presence
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). A corporation has physical presence nexus in Oregon if it has: an office, warehouse, or other place of business in Oregon; employees working in Oregon; tangible personal property located in Oregon; or real property located in Oregon. Reference: ORS 317.010-317.665 (Corporation Excise Tax), Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Filing requirements), Oregon Department of Revenue Corporate Income Tax Guide."

policy_statement.policy_description: OR filing required due to economic nexus
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Economic nexus threshold: $750,000 in Oregon sales (higher than the typical $100,000 threshold). Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), Oregon requires filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence. Oregon uses a higher economic nexus threshold ($750,000) compared to most states that use $100,000 or $500,000 thresholds. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), Oregon Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance, ORS 317.010 (Definitions and nexus standards)."

policy_statement.policy_description: No OR nexus - no filing requirement
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No OR nexus - no filing requirement. Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments would be refunded. Reference: ORS 317.010 (Nexus requirements)."

policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. OR ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to OR); IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (OR conformity varies); state income tax refunds included in federal income; bonus depreciation addback (OR may decouple from federal accelerated depreciation); expenses related to income exempt from Oregon tax. OR SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: interest on Oregon state and municipal bonds (exempt for OR purposes); Oregon net operating loss deduction (subject to OR limitations); dividends from certain subsidiaries (subject to ownership requirements); federal income taxes paid (to extent included in federal taxable income). Reference: Oregon Form 20 Schedule OR-ASC (Additions and Subtractions), ORS 317.267 (Oregon taxable income determination), Oregon Department of Revenue Publication 17-118 (Federal tax changes)."
"No nexus - no state adjustments calculated. Corporation does not have OR nexus, so no income adjustments are needed."

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income (still owe minimum tax!)
action_details.action_description: No excise tax, but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES

policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR state corporate excise tax calculation (FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS): 1. Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28]; 2. Apportioned to OR × [Single-sales apportionment %]; 3. OR additions + [Federal interest, 199A addback, etc.]; 4. OR subtractions - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, etc.]; 5. OR taxable income = [Result]; 6. OR tax rate × 7.6% (FINANCIAL INSTITUTION RATE); 7. OR excise tax = [Tax before minimum]; 8. OR minimum tax = [Based on Oregon sales - see ORS 317.090]; 9. OR tax before credits = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax); 10. OR credits - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion credits]; 11. OR tax liability = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits). Note: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.061(2) (Financial institution tax rate - 7.6%), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule), ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment)."

"OR state corporate excise tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28]; 2. Apportioned to OR × [Single-sales apportionment %]; 3. OR additions + [Federal interest, 199A addback, state tax refunds, etc.]; 4. OR subtractions - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, qualified dividends, etc.]; 5. OR taxable income = [Result]; 6. OR tax rate × 6.6% (flat rate for regular corporations); 7. OR excise tax = [Tax before minimum]; 8. OR minimum tax = [Based on Oregon sales - see schedule below]; 9. OR tax before credits = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax); 10. OR credits - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion, etc.]; 11. OR tax liability = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits). CRITICAL: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount. Oregon Minimum Tax Schedule (ORS 317.090): Less than $500,000 in OR sales: $150; $500,000 to $999,999: $500; $1 million to $1.999 million: $1,000; $2 million to $2.999 million: $1,500; $3 million to $4.999 million: $2,000; $5 million to $6.999 million: $4,000; $7 million to $9.999 million: $7,500; $10 million to $24.999 million: $15,000; $25 million to $49.999 million: $30,000; $50 million to $74.999 million: $50,000; $75 million to $99.999 million: $75,000; $100 million or more: $100,000. Oregon provides various tax credits including: Film and video production credit; Renewable energy development credit; Business expansion credit; Housing development credit. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.061(1) (Tax rate - 6.6%), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule), ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment), Oregon Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Credits Guide."

policy_statement.policy_description: No OR nexus - no tax liability
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No OR nexus - no tax liability. Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in OR. Any estimated payments are refunded. Reference: ORS 317.010 (Nexus requirements)."

policy_statement.policy_description: No OR taxable income - but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No OR taxable income - but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES. Corporation has OR nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. However, Oregon MINIMUM TAX is still required based on Oregon sales. CRITICAL: Even with no taxable income or a loss, corporations with Oregon nexus must pay the minimum tax. The minimum tax ranges from $150 to $100,000 based on Oregon sales. Oregon net operating loss (NOL) rules: Oregon allows NOL carryforward; Carryback rules vary by tax year; NOL does not eliminate minimum tax requirement. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax - applies regardless of income), ORS 317.476 (Net operating loss deduction)."
